sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: LiveWyer Insight and srs-context read best; the programme, muSrs, the spec and the clerk handbook each fail at the front door or in structure, and the shared packages give almost no labels or reading views.

sections.name: read
sections.label: What it says
sections.content: The front door is the commonest failure: three of six open on an identity that is not a guide, and two on a document that renders nothing. Structure fails by reach (a quarter to a third unreachable in three corpora) and by walls. Reading fails in the shared packages: labels below half and almost no views, which no single repository can fix alone. Semantics stay intact everywhere (no validation errors), except that affirmation repeats 42% of the programme's records.
